lines.text: Jesus says the world hated Him first, and it hates the disciples because He chose them out of the world.
Jesus says no servant is greater than his master, and they will persecute the disciples because of His name.
Jesus says whoever hates Him hates John the Baptist as well, and that hatred fulfills what is written in their Law.
Jesus says the Spirit of truth will testify about Him, and the disciples must testify because they have been with Him from the beginning.
Jesus says they will put the disciples out of the temples, so that the disciples will remember He told them.
